title: Reading Drill — Reusing labels in an archive — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Reusing labels in an archive — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Millcross began with reports of sticky residue obscuring folder numbers. The archive technician had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using inspection reports and chose the number of damaged labels as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was card holders on each folder. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted six weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded the age of the adhesive as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
